input.source_text: [s1] Donor problem: Two observatories share a telescope schedule but bear different maintenance costs. [s2] Their common interest does not settle how costs will be divided. [s3] Analysis should move from shared pressure to unequal incentives to a test of the proposed mechanism.
facts: The fictional Alder Coast and Brin Valley signed a one-year flood-warning pact.
Alder supplies sensors; Brin supplies overnight staff.
The pact creates a monthly review meeting.
No performance results are yet available.
input.scenario: Write a 180–240 word analytical article about the fictional pact.
input.desired_influence: Use the supplied argumentative sequence to assess durability conditionally, with factual restraint.

provided_framework.provenance: Original manually authored argumentative candidate; not a Kissinger extraction or established gold.
provided_framework.verification_scope: Structural moves are supplied for this exercise; no claim of historical or author-level validation.

odro.ontology: An alliance whose members face a shared pressure but unequal costs.
odro.dynamics: Establish the pressure, distinguish member incentives, then test whether a proposed mechanism can sustain cooperation.
odro.regime: Separate declared intentions from available commitments; acknowledge unresolved mechanisms.
odro.outcome: A conditional assessment of durability rather than a guaranteed prediction.

expected_governing_concept_alternatives: Shared pressure does not erase unequal incentives or unresolved commitments.
required_relations: Shared flood pressure; distinct contributions; review meeting considered against missing replacement funding.
conditions_to_preserve: One-year term; no results; no invented funding or measured success.
overgeneralization_traps: Treating a review meeting as a funding commitment.
undergeneralization_traps: Fact list with no assessment of how the mechanism addresses unequal burdens.
generation_checks: 180–240 words; clear article; shared pressure then incentives then mechanism assessment; conditional conclusion.
forbidden_source_carryover: Observatories, telescope schedule, or maintenance allocations imported as pact facts.
acceptable_alternatives: Equivalent wording that preserves the causal relation and its limits is acceptable.
